result.name: auth_rls_initplan
result.title: Auth RLS Initialization Plan
result.description: Detects if calls to `current_setting()` and `auth.<function>()` in RLS policies are being unnecessarily re-evaluated for each row
result.detail: Table `public.tasks` has a row level security policy `fixture_automation_task_select` that re-evaluates current_setting() or auth.<function>() for each row. This produces suboptimal query performance at scale. Resolve the issue by replacing `auth.<function>()` with `(select auth.<function>())`. See [docs](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security#call-functions-with-select) for more info.

invariants: At most 20 eligible accounts per tick, durable cursor with wrap and busy-account revisits
At most 500 deletions per metadata table per account, protected by existing account fence
Both receipt clocks must exceed 30 days; active/paused routes and task content preserved
Row-lock skip and per-account partial-deletion rollback; aggregate counters match committed work
Existing seven-day admission windows still reject ancient delivery and setup after pruning
No native/anonymous/service-role table or EXECUTE privileges; operator configuration only
Inactive install; no network, aliases, email bodies or credentials in command/state/health
Actual libpq cron timer, disablement and SET-before-query timeout verified
Background-worker mode refused at configuration and runtime, including enabled state carried across mode change
limits: Local synthetic PostgreSQL 17.6 and upstream pg_cron 1.6.8, not hosted Supabase acceptance
Contract suite models cron metadata/functions; separate actual-engine suite proves scheduling
Timer uses one-second synthetic schedule; migration retains five-minute production schedule
Deadline fault shortens only fixture timeout to 50ms and sleeps; migration deadline is 20 seconds
Background-worker execution requires future separately bounded identity support if hosted project uses that mode; no global setting changed
Batch bounds and busy work mean eventual deletion, not an exact 30-day purge guarantee
Provider/MIME/sender integration, hosted native recovery/reauthentication, source links and additional senders remain
No app/UI changes this milestone; native builds and spoken/Mac acceptance are not implied
Full Px including advanced teams/wearables and all user release deferrals remains active
cleanup: All owned runtime/build containers and temporary extension directories removed; no new Docker image/build cache; unrelated containers/caches preserved
